title: Persona Dosing: Calibrated Activation Steering for Graded Trait Control
abstract: arXiv:2609.36388v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An activation-steering coefficient sets intervention strength, but requesting a particular degree of persona expression requires a behavioral scale. We study persona dosing: controlling a language model through a trait description and a requested mean intensity. PersonaDose specializes a shared, description-conditioned FLAS controller on persona responses, then calibrates its flow time against measured trait expression. Training responses are not paired with requested target intensities. Across Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen3-8B, and Gemma-3-4B, PersonaDose raises core-trait expression at the Persona Vectors coherence floor of 75 by 33.2, 18.3, and 17.8 points over contrastive activation addition. Calibration-selected settings retain an expression advantage on held-out questions, although the coherence floor does not hold for every trait there. Across seven trained traits, calibrated requests yield mean targeting errors of 4.7-6.2 points over 14-22

translated_title: 人格剂量：用于分级特质控制的校准激活引导
translated_abstract: 激活引导系数决定了干预强度，但若要请求特定程度的人格表达，则需要一个行为量表。我们研究“人格剂量”问题：通过特质描述和所要求的平均强度来控制语言模型。PersonaDose 将一个共享的、以描述为条件的 FLAS 控制器在人格响应上进行专门化，然后根据测得的特质表达来校准其流时间。训练响应并不与所请求的目标强度配对。在 Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-8B 和 Gemma-3-4B 上，在 Persona Vectors 相干性地板为 75 的条件下，PersonaDose 相比对比激活添加分别将核心特质表达提升了 33.2、18.3 和 17.8 个百分点。通过校准选定的设置在留出问题上仍保持表达优势，尽管相干性地板并非对所有特质都成立。在七个训练特质上，校准请求在 14-22（范围内）产生 4.7-6.2 个百分点的平均目标误差。
tldr: 提出 PersonaDose，一种通过特质描述与请求强度实现“人格剂量”式校准激活引导的方法，无需强度配对的训练数据即可在多个大语言模型上精确、分级地控制人格特质的表达强度并保持连贯性。
en_tdlr: PersonaDose introduces calibrated activation steering that enables graded persona trait control from a trait description and requested intensity, achieving large expression gains and low targeting errors across multiple LLMs without paired training data.
